messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — planning a small release (service: routing, version: 0.19.3) tomorrow 09:00 PT. Target: bugfix + metrics tweak. Please review RN draft: https://docs.example.com/rn/0.19.3
Kevin Patel: On it. Which routes are we pinning for canary?
Maria Chen: Canary traffic pinned to v0.19.2-stable (10% for 15m). Full rollout to v0.19.3 after green. Region overrides for EU to follow.
Sasha Li: QA flagged a minor hallucination regression on one prompt after quant changes. We have fallback model variant v0.19.1-variant ready. Put that in the runbook.
Jules R: Add explicit rollback criteria in the RN: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 10m.
Oncall Emma: I'll be primary oncall for the window. Ping me directly if we see spikes.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Runbook: /runbooks/release-0.19.3. Notifications will post to #eng-oncall. :robot_face:
Kevin Patel: Can we pin the embed model to quant-opt-2 for EU region only (to preserve latency)?
Maria Chen: Yes — I'll add a region override to the deploy config and RN.
Sasha Li: Draft RN blurb for internal announce: "Release 0.19.3 — routing bugfix, minor model quant tweak, batching improvement. Canary 10% -> 100% if green. Oncall: Emma. Rollback criteria documented."
Maria Chen: Saved that wording. Plan: post internal announce to #eng + email partners at T+30m.
Jules R: Include literal rollback command in runbook so triage is fast: `/deploy rollback service=routing to=0.19.1 --reason="regression"`. Tested in staging.
deploy-bot: quick status hooks will run at +5m: canary health check, metric diffs, and deploybot heartbeat. Alerts bound to SRE paging if threshold crossed.
Oncall Emma: If rollback needed I'll coordinate node drains and pin traffic to stable. Call sequence in runbook covers that.
Kevin Patel: One more: add token-level cost delta in the RN. Expected small increase (~0.3%) due to quant tradeoff; mention to partners.
Maria Chen: Added cost note and region override. Final RN doc: https://docs.example.com/rn/0.19.3 (last updated). I'll push internal announce copy in 30m for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
